title: Go Fish
description: Go Fish for two to four people and one phone, played in bright deep water with fish drifting past the cards. The phone goes round the table behind a cover that names whoever should be holding it, so a hand is only ever secret while it is in the right hands. On your turn you may only ask for a rank you are actually holding — the rule casual play forgets — and the phone enforces it by only offering the ranks in your fan. Every ask is then read out loud on a big public board that prints the same words upside down as well, so the person opposite reads it too: that overheard information is the entire game. Four of a kind is a book, and a book lands with a slam, a shockwave and a burst of bubbles. Most books when the ocean runs dry wins the table.
